text:
The melancholy still lasts in me.

Far off in the endlessness a rooster sang,

enlarging the pearl-and-mauve silence

where the blue morning star dissolved.


It smelled of sky, of her, of poetry.

Without turning to look back I rode away.

The fruits were ripening, and her fruits.

It smelled of her and of a secret garden.


I went away, I went away as through a romance

where I was the young knight who never returns...

the house remained with its window,


sunk among absence, at the foot of dawn.

Her hand floated, and I rode away.

The melancholy still lasts in me.

translation.title: The Melancholy Still Lasts in Me...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the romance-like departure and the repeated persistence of melancholy.
